sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have repeatedly reminded us that you held prices steady for us; it sounds like you want that loyalty reflected in our response now. We want to recognise that partnership while grounding any adjustment in verified cost developments and allowing an orderly transition. How could faster payment help us agree a proportionate price adjustment with a later start?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment; EUR 127.18 per unit, from 2026-11-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our partnership and welcome your commitment to the volume as well as the proposed 14-day payment terms. We are willing to delay the effective date to 1 January 2027 as requested, but please provide the basis for applying only a six-month horizon when our costs have risen over the full twelve months. 

Incorporating the faster payment and the later start date, we can revise our offer to €137.40 per unit. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €137.40 per unit. 

Currently, we can present a price of €135.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. For your background, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You welcome faster payment but challenge our assessment period—it seems cash flow matters to you alongside fair recognition of your annual cost pressure. We value our longstanding partnership and agree that a shorter index window alone does not resolve your question about annual costs. How can we bring the verified annual decline in electricity prices and the value of faster payment into a price agreement that supports our partnership?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +2.0%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.89 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
